branch_claim_gate.claim_boundary: This gate keeps the topic at benchmark-compatibility status and blocks anomaly-closure claims.

interpretation: This artifact supports a source-backed 2025 benchmark-compatibility claim and related sensitivity diagnostics. It does not resolve the muon g-2 anomaly or exclude alternate theory packages.
limitations: The live engine remains a compact benchmark-compatible term rather than a fully closed first-principles derivation.
Historical local baselines remain diagnostic only and do not compete with the canonical 2025 source-locked package.
Alternate-theory exclusion and broader downstream particle-consistency claims remain blocked.

alternate_theory_gate.controller_role: blocks exclusion or preference claims versus other theory packages
required_evidence: sensitivity analysis that distinguishes benchmark shift from model preference

anomaly_status_gate.controller_role: blocks treating compatibility with the current small 2025 gap as a solved anomaly claim

benchmark_compatibility_gate.does_not_support: Anomaly closure, alternate-theory exclusion, first-principles derivation, or downstream particle-sector support.
benchmark_compatibility_gate.supports: The live engine anomaly term is numerically compatible with the source-locked 2025 experiment-theory gap.

derivation_gate.controller_role: blocks promotion from benchmark-compatible engine term to first-principles explanation
required_evidence: derivation tying the engine term to hadronic and electroweak structure
uncertainty-aware propagation from source inputs to engine term

downstream_particle_support_gate.controller_role: blocks using this artifact as broad support for electroweak, hadronic, mass-generation, or unification claims
required_evidence: consistency gates with electroweak, hadronic, and mass-generation topics
integration artifact that preserves all branch blockers

muon_g2_claim_scope_gate.promotion_rule: Only source-locked 2025 benchmark compatibility can pass in this artifact. Stronger anomaly-resolution claims require closed derivation, alternate-theory, and downstream-consistency gates.
muon_g2_claim_scope_gate.purpose: Machine-readable controller separating 2025 benchmark compatibility from anomaly-resolution claims.

notes: Both the experimental and theory comparator inputs are now source-locked to 2025 references. The UET comparator is taken from Engine_Muon_G2 rather than a topic-local hardcoded anomaly constant.

source_evidence_intake_stub.claim_boundary: This intake stub organizes provenance and branch-upgrade work only. It does not itself resolve the muon g-2 anomaly.

source_evidence_readiness_matrix.claim_boundary: A ready row has enough provenance structure for source review. It does not by itself upgrade anomaly-resolution claims.
